'''Monet''' is an NPC in {{location|Ragunna}}, found in [[Bank Street]], talking to [[Andrade]] from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Monet:''' Hands, ah, those hands...
:'''Andreade:''' What? Running low on cash, buddy?
:'''Monet:''' What's a few lousy coins? The real treasure is those delicate hands at the counter.
:'''Monet:''' Gold and jewels dance like silk across her fingers—so enticing.
:'''Monet:''' A charm is impossible to resist...
:'''Andreade:''' I heard she's the youngest daughter of the Montelli family, future heiress to the bank.
:'''Monet:''' Whether she's a lady of Septimont or the Montelli heiress...
:'''Monet:''' This alluring treasure will be mine, one way or another.
{{Dialogue End}}
